"""First-use profile setup; never replace an existing user's settings."""
import json
import os
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from .application_config import load_catalog, reject_secrets


class SetupError(ValueError):
    pass


def _file(value, label, suffix):
    if not str(value).strip():
        raise SetupError(f"Choose the {label} file.")
    path = Path(str(value).strip()).expanduser()
    if not path.is_absolute() or not path.is_file():
        raise SetupError(f"Choose an existing {label} file using Browse.")
    if path.suffix.lower() != suffix:
        raise SetupError(f"Choose a {suffix} file for {label}.")
    return path.resolve()


def prepare_profile(paths, template, driver, soap, email=""):
    """Validate a candidate in temporary storage before creating a profile."""
    template = _file(template, "team configuration", ".json")
    driver = _file(driver, "EdgeDriver", ".exe")
    soap = _file(soap, "SoapUI project", ".xml")
    if driver.name.lower() != "msedgedriver.exe":
        raise SetupError("Choose msedgedriver.exe, not the Microsoft Edge browser.")
    try:
        source = json.loads(template.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        if not isinstance(source, dict) or set(source) != {"applications"}:
            raise SetupError("Use the team setup file containing only application settings.")
        reject_secrets(source)
        if not isinstance(source["applications"], dict):
            raise SetupError("The team setup file needs an applications object.")
        settings = {
            "applications": source["applications"],
            "browser": {
                "driver_mode": "local",
                "driver_path": str(driver),
                "headless": False,
            },
        }
        # Replace team-specific SOAP paths with the user's selected resource.
        definitions = [
            json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            for p in sorted(paths.catalog.glob("*.json"))
        ]
        for app in definitions:
            if app.get("executor") == "soapui":
                override = settings["applications"].setdefault(app["app_id"], {})
                override.setdefault("data", {})["soapui_project"] = str(soap)
        if email.strip():
            from .mail import validate_mail
            settings["mail"] = validate_mail({
                "transport": "outlook",
                "sender": email.strip(),
                "recipients": [email.strip()],
            })
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ahc-setup-") as temp:
            candidate = Path(temp) / "candidate.json"
            candidate.write_text(json.dumps(settings), encoding="utf-8")
            apps, _ = load_catalog(paths.catalog, candidate)
            if any(
                app["enabled"] and any(
                    not app.get("data", {}).get(field)
                    for field in app["local_fields"]
                )
                for app in apps
            ):
                raise SetupError("The team configuration is missing required application data.")
        return settings
    except SetupError:
        raise
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
        raise SetupError(
            "Setup could not validate these choices. Check the team configuration, "
            "selected files and email address."
        ) from None


def _publish(source, target):
    if os.name == "nt":
        # Windows rename refuses to replace an existing destination.
        os.rename(source, target)
    else:
        os.link(source, target)


def save_profile(paths, settings):
    """Publish a complete settings file atomically, without overwriting one."""
    target = paths.overrides
    if target.exists():
        raise SetupError("Settings already exist. Close setup and reopen the app.")
    temporary = None
    try:
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
            mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=target.parent,
            prefix=".setup-", suffix=".tmp", delete=False,
        ) as handle:
            temporary = Path(handle.name)
            json.dump(settings, handle, indent=2)
            handle.write("\n")
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        _publish(temporary, target)
    except FileExistsError:
        raise SetupError("Settings already exist. Close setup and reopen the app.") from None
    except OSError:
        raise SetupError("Settings could not be saved in your personal app folder.") from None
    finally:
        if temporary is not None:
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def show_first_run(paths, template_path):
    """Return True after setup or for an existing profile; False on Cancel."""
    if paths.overrides.is_file():
        return True
    import tkinter as tk
    from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title("AppHealthChecker - First-time setup")
    root.minsize(720, 390)
    root.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    frame = ttk.Frame(root, padding=20)
    frame.grid(sticky="nsew")
    frame.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
    ttk.Label(frame, text="Set up your profile", font=("Segoe UI", 15, "bold")).grid(
        row=0, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=(0, 8))
    ttk.Label(frame, text=(
        "Choose the team setup file and resources you can access.\n"
        "Your settings and new History will be stored in your personal app folder."
    )).grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=(0, 16))

    template = tk.StringVar(value=str(template_path) if Path(template_path).is_file() else "")
    driver = tk.StringVar()
    soap = tk.StringVar()
    email = tk.StringVar()
    outlook = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
    completed = False

    def file_row(row, label, variable, filetypes):
        ttk.Label(frame, text=label).grid(row=row, column=0, sticky="w", padx=(0, 12))
        ttk.Entry(frame, textvariable=variable, width=52).grid(
            row=row, column=1, sticky="ew", pady=6)

        def browse():
            chosen = filedialog.askopenfilename(parent=root, title=label, filetypes=filetypes)
            if chosen:
                variable.set(chosen)

        ttk.Button(frame, text="Browse...", command=browse).grid(
            row=row, column=2, padx=(8, 0))

    file_row(2, "Team configuration", template, [("JSON files", "*.json")])
    file_row(3, "EdgeDriver", driver, [("EdgeDriver", "msedgedriver.exe")])
    file_row(4, "SoapUI project", soap, [("XML files", "*.xml")])
    ttk.Checkbutton(frame, text="Set up classic Outlook email (optional)", variable=outlook,
                    command=lambda: email_entry.configure(
                        state="normal" if outlook.get() else "disabled")).grid(
        row=5, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=(12, 4))
    ttk.Label(frame, text="Your email address").grid(row=6, column=0, sticky="w")
    email_entry = ttk.Entry(frame, textvariable=email, state="disabled")
    email_entry.grid(row=6, column=1, sticky="ew", pady=6)
    ttk.Label(frame, text=(
        "Email starts as self-to-self. Setup does not send email or save passwords.\n"
        "After setup, use Environment and Self-Test before running checkouts."
    )).grid(row=7, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=(10, 12))

    def finish():
        nonlocal completed
        if outlook.get() and not email.get().strip():
            messagebox.showerror("Setup", "Enter your Outlook email address.", parent=root)
            return
        try:
            settings = prepare_profile(paths, template.get(), driver.get(), soap.get(),
                                       email.get() if outlook.get() else "")
            save_profile(paths, settings)
        except SetupError as exc:
            messagebox.showerror("Setup", str(exc), parent=root)
            return
        completed = True
        root.destroy()

    buttons = ttk.Frame(frame)
    buttons.grid(row=8, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="e")
    ttk.Button(buttons, text="Cancel", command=root.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=8)
    ttk.Button(buttons, text="Save and continue", command=finish).pack(side="left")
    root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", root.destroy)
    root.mainloop()
    return completed
